args.query: học kỳ hè tối thiểu 5 tuần

cases.answer: A summer term lasts at least 5 weeks, so at most 5 credits may be taken in it [[qd-1175-2021/d6/k4/a]].
cases.harm: search pulls a clause whose 5 grounds an invented summer cap
